channels.C1: Thank you for reaching out, and we're sorry to hear about the water damage to your home. Your claim for the burst pipe has been opened, and your policy is active. An adjuster will contact you soon to arrange a visit and walk you through the next steps. If anything changes before then, or you have questions, please let us know. We're here to help.
